steps.name: research_outline
steps.label: Research Outline
steps.description: Generates a chapter-by-chapter outline from title + topic.

steps.name: write_hook
steps.label: Write Hook
steps.description: Drafts the cold-open hook from the outline.

steps.name: write_chapters
steps.label: Write Chapters
steps.description: Drafts each chapter in batches against the running story-so-far summary.

steps.name: assemble_script
steps.label: Assemble Script
steps.description: Concatenates the hook and chapter files into the full script.

steps.name: voiceover
steps.label: Voiceover
steps.description: Synthesizes the script narration via the TTS provider.

steps.name: align
steps.label: Align
steps.description: Aligns the script against narration audio with whisper.cpp.

steps.name: chunk_clips_then_images
steps.label: Chunk (clips + images)
steps.description: Splits aligned sentences into a leading run of clip chunks and a body of image chunks.

steps.name: chunk_images_only
steps.label: Chunk (images only)
steps.description: Splits aligned sentences into image-paired chunks covering the full narration.

steps.name: chunk_clips_only
steps.label: Chunk (clips only)
steps.description: Splits aligned sentences into clip-paired chunks covering the full narration.

steps.name: generate_visual_prompts
steps.label: Generate visual prompts
steps.description: Generates a visual prompt for each chunk via batched LLM calls.

steps.name: generate_images
steps.label: Generate images
steps.description: Generates images for each image chunk via the workflow's image provider.

steps.name: generate_clips
steps.label: Generate clips
steps.description: Generates a video clip for each clip chunk via the workflow's video provider.

steps.name: draw_on_images
steps.label: Draw-on reveal clips
steps.description: Generates per-image draw-on reveal MP4 clips for doodle image styles.

steps.name: render
steps.label: Render
steps.description: Renders the final video with ffmpeg from chunks, audio, images, and clips.

steps.name: cleanup
steps.label: Cleanup
steps.description: Deletes intermediate artifacts; keeps final.mp4 and full_script.md.

steps.name: generate_loop_image
steps.label: Generate loop image
steps.description: Enqueues an image-hitl task on the magnific_queue and waits for the operator to pick a Magnific variation.

steps.name: generate_loop_clip
steps.label: Generate loop clip
steps.description: Enqueues an image-to-video task on the magnific_queue and waits for the Magnific Seedance executor to deliver the looped clip.

steps.name: make_thumbnail
steps.label: Make thumbnail
steps.description: Crops loop_image.png into a 1920×1080 thumbnail.jpg via ffmpeg.

steps.name: generate_music
steps.label: Generate music
steps.description: Stub: no-op until Plan 3 wires the Suno queue.

steps.name: download_music
steps.label: Download music
steps.description: Stub: synthesises N 1-second silent WAVs (one per song_count) under songs/.

steps.name: render_music_video
steps.label: Render music video
steps.description: Muxes the looped Magnific clip with silent audio (Plan 2) or the concatenated Suno songs (Plan 3) into final.mp4.
